start: Expenses screen as the owner, this month, some fees collected

user_sees: Title 'Expenses', under it 'What went out, and what the gym kept'
The month name with 'This month' under it and arrows for the month before and after
Three figures: 'Collected', 'Expenses', 'Profit'
'Expenses this month'
must_not: Collected showing receipts that were cancelled
The next-month arrow usable from this month

user_sees: Sheet 'Add expense'
Boxes 'Amount' with ₹, 'What for', 'Date' (today), 'Note (optional)'
Buttons 'Cancel' and 'Save expense'
must_not: The date empty

steps.action: Type 5000, pick what it was for, tap 'Save expense'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the sheet closes and a short message 'Expense added.'
The row in 'Expenses this month' with the day, the note and ₹5,000
'Expenses' up by 5,000 and 'Profit' down by 5,000
'By category' with the count and a bar
must_not: Two rows from one press
Profit that is not Collected minus Expenses

start: Expenses screen; the month arrows, and an expense dated in an older month

steps.action: Tap the arrow for the month before
user_sees: That month's name and its three figures
A link 'Back to this month'
must_not: This month's expenses counted in the older month

steps.action: Tap '+ Add expense', set the date in a month two back, save
user_sees: The screen jumps to that month and shows the new row
'Expense added.'
must_not: The expense landing in the month on screen instead of its own

user_sees: This month again with 'This month' under the name
must_not: Figures of the older month left on screen

steps.action: Tap 'Save expense' with the amount empty
user_sees: Under Amount: 'Type how much was spent.'
must_not: An expense of ₹0 saved

steps.action: Type letters in the amount, save
user_sees: 'That amount looks wrong. Type it again.'
must_not: A guessed amount saved

user_sees: 'Type an amount more than zero.'
must_not: A zero row in the list

steps.action: Set the date to tomorrow, save
user_sees: A red line: 'The expense date can’t be in the future.'
must_not: A future expense saved

steps.action: Set a date with a year far in the past, save
user_sees: 'That date looks wrong. Check the year.'
must_not: A row in a month nobody can reach

start: Expenses screen with one expense this month

user_sees: Sheet 'Remove this expense?'
'<amount> · <what for> (<day>) will be removed for good. You can’t get it back. You would have to add it again.'
Buttons 'Keep it' and 'Remove'
must_not: The expense removed before the second tap

user_sees: The row is still there
must_not: The row gone

steps.action: Tap 'Remove' on the row again, then 'Remove' in the sheet
user_sees: A short message 'Expense removed.'
The row is gone; 'Expenses' falls and 'Profit' rises by that amount
'No expenses this month' with its add button
must_not: The row back after a refresh
'Expense removed.' when the remove failed

steps.action: Add expenses larger than the month's collection
user_sees: 'Profit' in red, with 'Spent more than collected'
must_not: A loss shown as a profit

user_sees: Every figure and every Remove button
must_not: Expenses of another branch or gym mixed in
